erosion_index_E.note: E = sum_d (1-cover) x rain_risk x (1 + slope%/5); water days excluded

etc_mm_season.note: mean of 2015-2025 weather years. ETc = Kc(d) x ETo (FAO-56 eq. 6 PM, station Tmax/Tmin + POWER Rs/RH/wind; Kc FAO-56 Table 12 where verified); range = min/max over Kc low/high, ETo +/-15%, rice F 300-600 mm, precip sources ['NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR', 'NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station mean (regional cache)']. Crop, cover and flood days; bare days excluded.

etc_mm_year.note: mean of 2015-2025 weather years. ETc = Kc(d) x ETo (FAO-56 eq. 6 PM, station Tmax/Tmin + POWER Rs/RH/wind; Kc FAO-56 Table 12 where verified); range = min/max over Kc low/high, ETo +/-15%, rice F 300-600 mm, precip sources ['NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR', 'NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station mean (regional cache)']. All days incl. bare soil at Kc 0.15.

irrigation_need_mm.note: mean of 2015-2025 weather years. ETc = Kc(d) x ETo (FAO-56 eq. 6 PM, station Tmax/Tmin + POWER Rs/RH/wind; Kc FAO-56 Table 12 where verified); range = min/max over Kc low/high, ETo +/-15%, rice F 300-600 mm, precip sources ['NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR', 'NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station mean (regional cache)']. I = sum over irrigated seasons of monthly max(0, ETc - 0.8 P) (0.8 assumed) + rice F; averaged per cycle year.

irrigation_need_max_cycle_year_mm.note: Largest single cycle-year I (used for the allocation check)

openet_et_mm_season.note: OpenET Ensemble v2.1 annual ET, field polygon, mean of the years whose CDL crop is Alfalfa (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2024, 2025); low/high = driest/wettest of those years. Independent check only.

etc_vs_openet_pct.note: (engine annual ETc - OpenET) / OpenET, both on years 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2024, 2025. Engine 1343 mm (range 1142-1545) vs OpenET 1112 mm. Positive = engine higher. Default weather; no engine coefficient is fitted to OpenET. Main remaining gap is May-Oct (FAO-56 Kc above OpenET's ET/ETo); see backend/engine/README.md.

water.eto_source_note: ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (eq. 6) with NOAA GHCN-D station Tmax/Tmin (mean of the 3 regional-chunk stations; POWER on days none report) and POWER radiation, humidity (ea, eq. 19) and wind. Hargreaves (eq. 52) on POWER was the previous default; FAO-56 ch. 3 gives eq. 52 only as the alternative when radiation/humidity/wind are missing, and POWER Tmax reads +3.4-3.8 C warm in Jul-Aug vs the stations (backend/regional/README.md). CIMIS station ETo still blocked (key rejected).

water_use.note: 100 x clamp(1 - I/I_max); I_max = 1424 mm = largest I (high end) among this location's strategies, default years (our choice; spec does not define I_max). rule of thumb, not a model

forage_value.note: 100 x sum(rating/4 x months in field/12 x min(yield/10000,1)) / cycle_years, over harvested forage crops. Months in field replaces the count of harvest months (that count scored a one-cut silage crop below a multi-cut hay of similar dry matter). Range = rating and yield ranges (both assumed). rule of thumb, not a model

n_fixation.note: 100 x sum(rating_nfix/4 x months growing/12)/cycle_years, legumes only; ratings assumed, range = rating range. rule of thumb, not a model

erosion.note: Relative to today's rotation: 100 x E_baseline / (E_baseline + E). Today's rotation = 50; less rain-weighted bare exposure scores above 50 (no exposure = 100), more scores below 50 (twice today's = 33). Not clamped. Change in E vs today: +0.0%. The 30% residue-rating blend was dropped from the score (it made today's rotation score non-zero and mixed an absolute rating into a relative score); it is reported as residue_component. rule of thumb, not a model

exposure_component.note: 100 x (1 - E/E_baseline), NOT clamped: 0 for today's rotation, negative = more rain-weighted bare exposure than today; null if E_baseline = 0

residue_component.note: 100 x lasting_residue/4, crop-day mean rating. Shown for context, not part of the erosion score: residue would belong inside the cover term (RUSLE soil-loss-ratio subfactors, USDA Agriculture Handbook 703), which needs daily residue cover we do not have

slope_pct.note: Flat SJV field placeholder; NASADEM slope not yet supplied by backend/field. Cancels in E/E_baseline.

organic_matter.note: soil_builder 3.00, lasting_residue 1.00 (crop-day means), perennial years 1.00/1. Range = bare threshold/rain/precip combos and the rating ranges. rule of thumb, not a model

market.note: 50 +/- 25 by share of products matching 'no_preference' (sell: rice/hay/wheat; feed: silage/sorghum-sudan). Base 50 and the linear rule are ours. No uncertainty model. Always a local-review item. rule of thumb, not a model

pest_break.note: Adjusted formula: 100 x min(1, distinct families/3) x min(1, extra host-free years / 3). Host = today's main crop (Alfalfa (hay/haylage, multi-cut)); extra host-free years = (longest circular stretch without the host - today's) / 365, so today's rotation scores 0 and the normal winter gap earns nothing. 3 years for a full break from UC IPM alfalfa ('a 3- to 4-year nonhost crop rotation is ideal'); range 2-4 years; using it for rice is our assumption; UC IPM rice (https://ipm.ucanr.edu/agriculture/rice/integrated-weed-management/) names cereals, safflower and dry fallow as rotations out of rice. Families ['Fabaceae']; longest stretch without Alfalfa (hay/haylage, multi-cut) 0 d vs 0 d today = 0.00 extra host-free years. No pest dataset exists. rule of thumb, not a model

infiltration.note: compaction 3.00, root class 2.00, cover months 12.0; range = rating/root-class ranges. SSURGO hydrologic group C. rule of thumb, not a model

n_scavenging.note: 100 x rating/4 x fall-winter cover months/6, computed day by day over Oct-Mar with cover >= 0.5 (6.0 months); ratings assumed, range = rating range. rule of thumb, not a model

income.note: BLOCKED: Needs rice/wheat prices (NASS Quick Stats key), hay prices (AMS My Market News key, report slug assumed) and the EQIP 340 California rate (schedule not transcribed). Seed cost alone (assumed) would be ~300 USD/ha/yr.

seed_cost_per_ha.note: Sum of crop seed-cost placeholders per cycle year

eqip_340_rate.note: BLOCKED: California EQIP 340 rate not transcribed

composite.note: sum(W_i s_i) with W_i = w_i / sum(w); low/high = same weights on score lows/highs. rule of thumb, not a model

exposed_dry_days.note: mean of 2015-2025 weather years. Modelled cover from the calendar. Exposed = cover < 0.5 and not water. Dry-spell PROXY: POWER 30-day P < 50% of its 1991-2020 climatology (spec rule uses IMERG/SMAP, both blocked). In the dry Central Valley summer nearly every day qualifies, so this mostly counts bare summer days.

erosion_index_E.note: E = sum_d (1-cover) x rain_risk x (1 + slope%/5); water days excluded

etc_mm_season.note: mean of 2015-2025 weather years. ETc = Kc(d) x ETo (FAO-56 eq. 6 PM, station Tmax/Tmin + POWER Rs/RH/wind; Kc FAO-56 Table 12 where verified); range = min/max over Kc low/high, ETo +/-15%, rice F 300-600 mm, precip sources ['NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR', 'NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station mean (regional cache)']. Crop, cover and flood days; bare days excluded.

etc_mm_year.note: mean of 2015-2025 weather years. ETc = Kc(d) x ETo (FAO-56 eq. 6 PM, station Tmax/Tmin + POWER Rs/RH/wind; Kc FAO-56 Table 12 where verified); range = min/max over Kc low/high, ETo +/-15%, rice F 300-600 mm, precip sources ['NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR', 'NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station mean (regional cache)']. All days incl. bare soil at Kc 0.15.

irrigation_need_mm.note: mean of 2015-2025 weather years. ETc = Kc(d) x ETo (FAO-56 eq. 6 PM, station Tmax/Tmin + POWER Rs/RH/wind; Kc FAO-56 Table 12 where verified); range = min/max over Kc low/high, ETo +/-15%, rice F 300-600 mm, precip sources ['NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR', 'NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily station mean (regional cache)']. I = sum over irrigated seasons of monthly max(0, ETc - 0.8 P) (0.8 assumed) + rice F; averaged per cycle year.

irrigation_need_max_cycle_year_mm.note: Largest single cycle-year I (used for the allocation check)

openet_et_mm_season.note: BLOCKED: OpenET measures the crop actually grown on the field (the baseline); this alternative was not grown there.

etc_vs_openet_pct.note: BLOCKED: Only the baseline can be checked against OpenET.

water.eto_source_note: ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (eq. 6) with NOAA GHCN-D station Tmax/Tmin (mean of the 3 regional-chunk stations; POWER on days none report) and POWER radiation, humidity (ea, eq. 19) and wind. Hargreaves (eq. 52) on POWER was the previous default; FAO-56 ch. 3 gives eq. 52 only as the alternative when radiation/humidity/wind are missing, and POWER Tmax reads +3.4-3.8 C warm in Jul-Aug vs the stations (backend/regional/README.md). CIMIS station ETo still blocked (key rejected).

water_use.note: 100 x clamp(1 - I/I_max); I_max = 1424 mm = largest I (high end) among this location's strategies, default years (our choice; spec does not define I_max). rule of thumb, not a model

forage_value.note: 100 x sum(rating/4 x months in field/12 x min(yield/10000,1)) / cycle_years, over harvested forage crops. Months in field replaces the count of harvest months (that count scored a one-cut silage crop below a multi-cut hay of similar dry matter). Range = rating and yield ranges (both assumed). rule of thumb, not a model

n_fixation.note: 100 x sum(rating_nfix/4 x months growing/12)/cycle_years, legumes only; ratings assumed, range = rating range. rule of thumb, not a model

erosion.note: Relative to today's rotation: 100 x E_baseline / (E_baseline + E). Today's rotation = 50; less rain-weighted bare exposure scores above 50 (no exposure = 100), more scores below 50 (twice today's = 33). Not clamped. Change in E vs today: -12.4%. The 30% residue-rating blend was dropped from the score (it made today's rotation score non-zero and mixed an absolute rating into a relative score); it is reported as residue_component. rule of thumb, not a model

exposure_component.note: 100 x (1 - E/E_baseline), NOT clamped: 0 for today's rotation, negative = more rain-weighted bare exposure than today; null if E_baseline = 0

residue_component.note: 100 x lasting_residue/4, crop-day mean rating. Shown for context, not part of the erosion score: residue would belong inside the cover term (RUSLE soil-loss-ratio subfactors, USDA Agriculture Handbook 703), which needs daily residue cover we do not have

slope_pct.note: Flat SJV field placeholder; NASADEM slope not yet supplied by backend/field. Cancels in E/E_baseline.

organic_matter.note: soil_builder 2.43, lasting_residue 1.43 (crop-day means), perennial years 0.00/1. Range = bare threshold/rain/precip combos and the rating ranges. rule of thumb, not a model

market.note: 50 +/- 25 by share of products matching 'no_preference' (sell: rice/hay/wheat; feed: silage/sorghum-sudan). Base 50 and the linear rule are ours. No uncertainty model. Always a local-review item. rule of thumb, not a model

pest_break.note: Adjusted formula: 100 x min(1, distinct families/3) x min(1, extra host-free years / 3). Host = today's main crop (Alfalfa (hay/haylage, multi-cut)); extra host-free years = (longest circular stretch without the host - today's) / 365, so today's rotation scores 0 and the normal winter gap earns nothing. 3 years for a full break from UC IPM alfalfa ('a 3- to 4-year nonhost crop rotation is ideal'); range 2-4 years; using it for rice is our assumption; UC IPM rice (https://ipm.ucanr.edu/agriculture/rice/integrated-weed-management/) names cereals, safflower and dry fallow as rotations out of rice. Families ['Poaceae']; Alfalfa (hay/haylage, multi-cut) never grown in the modelled cycle (counted as a full break; the real break depends on the years around it). No pest dataset exists. rule of thumb, not a model

infiltration.note: compaction 2.00, root class 1.00, cover months 7.5; range = rating/root-class ranges. SSURGO hydrologic group C. rule of thumb, not a model

n_scavenging.note: 100 x rating/4 x fall-winter cover months/6, computed day by day over Oct-Mar with cover >= 0.5 (3.7 months); ratings assumed, range = rating range. rule of thumb, not a model

income.note: BLOCKED: Needs rice/wheat prices (NASS Quick Stats key), hay prices (AMS My Market News key, report slug assumed) and the EQIP 340 California rate (schedule not transcribed). Seed cost alone (assumed) would be ~140 USD/ha/yr.

seed_cost_per_ha.note: Sum of crop seed-cost placeholders per cycle year

eqip_340_rate.note: BLOCKED: California EQIP 340 rate not transcribed

composite.note: sum(W_i s_i) with W_i = w_i / sum(w); low/high = same weights on score lows/highs. rule of thumb, not a model

Cycle = 3 alfalfa production years + 1 break year (cereal to April, unirrigated summer fallow May-Aug, re-seed 20 Sept). Year numbering wraps: the stand seeded in year 4 produces in years 1-3 (labelled by the year its Dec-Nov season starts).
